issues.title: Client crash on creation of new channel
issues.body:
A game is live.

The Game Designer just added a channel, into which he put all forces.  When he clicked on "Save channel", Serge blue-screened.  Other logged in clients also blue-screened.  A refresh cleared the issue.

But, I couldn't reproduce the issue on a development machine. Maybe I wasn't creating a channel with the same constraints.

For further investigation.

comments.body:
Was able to reproduce channel.

- Add channel (traditional/normal type)
- Add all forces to channel
- Save channel

This error shown on console:
```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'channel')
at t.default (handle-channel-updates.ts:317:47)
at er (handleWargameChanges.ts:20:34)
at dr (pllayerUI_reducer.ts:170:34) 
```

Note: the above handle-channel-updates may not match the current `develop` branch, since `develop` now includes the fix to avoid duplicate messages.

Line 317 doesn't relate to an obvious instance of `channel` in the source code.

The `channel` variable in this method is the index value in `allChannels.forEach`.  That suggests that _somehow_ there is an empty channel in the list of channels.  _Maybe_ we need to drop out of the loop if the channel is empty. _Maybe_ we need to understand how/why there is an empty channel in the listing.

So, output each `channel` as we process it, but don't fall over if it's empty.

Have learned some more. The game that was breaking was at "Turn 0 - Adjudication", and contained no messages at all so far.

Once I'd moved forward a single turn to "Turn 1 - Planning Phase", the crash didn't happen.

The issue was not related to messages.  In a game at turn 0, with a single message, the crash still happens.

Ok, steps to reproduce:
- create new wargame
- add a new force "Blue", leave it with default role "CO"
- add a new force "Red", leave it with default role "CO"
- add a new channel "All chat", put white and blue into it
- in player window, login as Blue
- in Admin window, remove Red from channel. Save channel. See blue screen appear

> * add a new channel "All chat", put white and blue into it

It crashes for me when I click on the channel tab (#1615), so I can't reproduce this.
